threads.body: The `extends` array is missing a comma between entries (after "helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver"), which makes this JSON5 invalid and will break Renovate config parsing. Add the missing comma (and keep consistent trailing commas as needed).

This file uses tab indentation inside the `exclude` array, but `.editorconfig` sets `indent_style = space` for `[*]`. Replace tabs with spaces here to match the repo-wide formatting rules and avoid whitespace churn in future edits.

Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/commit/02a54c79a2d062cda81542e3d9cd40a4e75efb34.

This replaces the tabs in the lychee exclude array with two-space indentation to match .editorconfig.

threads.body: Renaming the workflow from "GenAI Reference Implementation Tests" to "CI" will change the check-run context for the aggregate gate (e.g., from `GenAI Reference Implementation Tests / required-status-check` to `CI / required-status-check`). That means existing branch protection rules won’t continue working without updating the required status check name, which conflicts with the PR description’s claim that branch protection can remain unchanged. Consider keeping the workflow name stable or explicitly calling out that branch protection needs a one-time update.

replies.body: Good catch. The admin ruleset requires the unqualified `required-status-check` job context, so the workflow rename does not require a branch-protection update. I updated the PR description to avoid claiming the workflow-qualified `CI / required-status-check` context is required.

threads.body: This job checks external URLs on `pull_request` runs. Because PR content is user-controlled, this makes outbound network requests to arbitrary hosts/ports from GitHub-hosted runners (SSRF-style probing risk) and can also introduce flaky CI due to external site instability. Consider restricting external link checking for PRs (especially from forks) to an allowlist, or only checking repository-local links on PRs and reserving full external checks for pushes/merge queue on trusted branches.

replies.body: Thanks, this is a fair hardening concern. After weighing it for this repo, we are keeping PR external link checks enabled on GitHub-hosted runners so contributor PRs get the same link validation signal; the Lychee timeout/retry settings are now bounded to reduce flaky or slow external checks.
